instruction: Please start the video playback in VLC media player from: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YQHsXMglC9A

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Adele - Hello). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type). Task maintains identical structure and difficulty as the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly checks if VLC is playing and attempts to verify the YouTube URL
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly fetches VLC status from HTTP interface
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses XML, checks state='playing', and validates URL for type='url'
Coverage is complete: verifies both playback state and correct video URL
Metric includes multiple URL matching methods (direct match, filename match, domain/path comparison) to handle various VLC URL representations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor uncertainty: YouTube streaming URLs in VLC status.xml may differ from original watch URLs (VLC shows resolved stream URLs like googlevideo.com). The metric's fallback URL matching logic should handle this, but runtime behavior depends on what VLC actually stores in status.xml metadata
Consider adding logging or verification that VLC preserves YouTube watch URL information in status.xml when streaming from YouTube
